name: lofi-theme
description: A lofi living room behind the chat in the Claude desktop app: the light follows your clock, and an orange mascot and a kitten react to what the session is doing.

clockFormat.title: Clock format
clockFormat.description: How the wall clock shows the hour: 24h (17:05) or 12h (05:05).

timeOfDay.title: Time of day
timeOfDay.description: auto lights the room by your clock (dawn, day, golden hour, dusk, night). Name one to keep the room in that light.

wall.title: Wall colour
wall.description: The colour of the room's wall.

kitten.title: Kitten
kitten.description: Off for a room with no kitten in it.

celebrations.title: Celebrations
celebrations.description: Confetti on a commit, fireworks on a merged pull request, a cheer or a facepalm on a test run. Off keeps the room calm.

rain.title: Rainy days
rain.description: About one day in five it rains outside the window. Off keeps the sky clear.

tv.title: Wall TV
tv.description: A TV on the wall that shows your 5-hour and weekly usage, the project and chat, and how full the context is. Off takes it down.
